exposure: timing of initiation of therapeutic hypothermia (TH)
cohort: The study included 187 exclusively inborn neonates diagnosed with moderate to severe hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) from a high-volume, urban, safety net hospital, primarily serving racial/ethnic minority patients.
finding: In this vulnerable population, the timing of initiation of therapeutic hypothermia was not associated with short-term outcomes, including in-hospital death, abnormal brain MRI, or length of stay.
